items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: Monk's Music Gigi, Blakey, I said Coltrane

And Monk called me up just to play on one track of his Thelonious's album, his solo album. And about this time, Johnnie Griffin was in New York; Jimmy Mann was there working, and Wilbur Camel came out from Chicago, so Keepnews people said, 'well, it's time for your own ...' he didn't call me until Lionel phoned me; he got word to me, and he say, 'You got a date tomorrow', and I said, 'My date? I got no material.' And he said, 'Well, you be in the studio at such and such a time.'
Thelonious Himself Johnny Junior Mance Campbell
